products.name: Premium Black Oxford Shirt
products.shortDescription: Tailored 100% combed cotton Oxford weave with structured collar and mother-of-pearl buttons.
products.description: Crafted for the modern Pakistani gentleman, the Premium Black Oxford Shirt pairs effortless versatility with structured tailoring. Woven from breathable long-staple cotton in a dense Oxford texture, it transitions seamlessly from corporate boardrooms in Sialkot to evening dinners.

products.name: Classic White Formal Shirt
products.shortDescription: Crisp wrinkle-resistant twill formal shirt with semi-spread collar and tailored cuffs.
products.description: An indispensable wardrobe cornerstone. Our Classic White Formal Shirt features a fine two-ply twill weave that resists creasing throughout the day while offering a smooth, luminous finish under suiting or worn solo.

products.name: Navy Blue Casual Shirt
products.shortDescription: Soft-washed breathable poplin shirt in deep navy with a modern relaxed silhouette.
products.description: Designed for refined everyday wear, the Navy Blue Casual Shirt is garment-washed for immediate softness. Features tonal stitching, a chest pocket, and a curved hem that looks sharp tucked or untucked.

products.name: Premium Check Shirt
products.shortDescription: Yarn-dyed micro-check pattern with brushed cotton finish and button-down collar.
products.description: Featuring a sophisticated yarn-dyed check pattern, this shirt offers depth of color that never fades. Tailored with precision at the shoulders and chest for a clean, contemporary profile.

products.name: Olive Green Casual Shirt
products.shortDescription: Earth-toned breathable cotton-linen blend shirt built for all-season comfort.
products.description: Our Olive Green Casual Shirt brings understated military-inspired heritage into modern Pakistani streetwear. Pair it effortlessly with khaki chinos or dark blue denim.

products.name: Premium Denim Shirt
products.shortDescription: Mid-weight selvedge-inspired denim overshirt with antique brass snap hardware.
products.description: Built from durable 7oz ring-spun denim, the Premium Denim Shirt wears equally well as a standalone statement piece or layered open over a crisp tee. Develops unique character with every wear.

products.name: Classic Black Trousers
products.shortDescription: Sharp flat-front tailored formal trousers with comfort waistband and crease retention.
products.description: Engineered for all-day poise, our Classic Black Trousers feature a tailored taper from knee to ankle, reinforced hook-and-bar closure, and breathable pocket linings.

products.name: Slim Fit Navy Pants
products.shortDescription: Four-way stretch slim-tailored navy trousers for executive and smart-casual styling.
products.description: Combining bespoke sartorial lines with modern stretch recovery, the Slim Fit Navy Pants deliver a sharp silhouette without restricting movement. Pairs seamlessly with white or black Oxford shirts.

products.name: Premium Khaki Chinos
products.shortDescription: Peached cotton stretch twill chinos with coin pocket and clean double-welt back pockets.
products.description: Our Premium Khaki Chinos are crafted from peached compact cotton twill with a hint of elastane. Soft to the touch yet structured enough for year-round rotation.

products.name: Dark Blue Denim Jeans
products.shortDescription: 12.5oz premium dark indigo stretch denim with subtle whiskering and chain-stitched hems.
products.description: Constructed from high-recovery Pakistani export-grade denim, these Dark Blue Denim Jeans offer a rich indigo cast, custom copper rivets, and a modern regular-slim cut.

products.name: Black Stretch Jeans
products.shortDescription: Fade-resistant reactive-dyed black denim with superior flex and matte black hardware.
products.description: Designed to stay pitch-black wash after wash, our Black Stretch Jeans combine urban edge with supreme comfort. Features tonal black topstitching and matte gunmetal hardware.

products.name: Light Grey Formal Trousers
products.shortDescription: Refined sharkskin-weave light grey dress trousers ideal for daytime events and office wear.
products.description: Tailored in a sophisticated melange grey tone, these trousers pair effortlessly with dark blazers, navy shirts, and brown leather footwear.

products.name: Premium Black Formal Shoes
products.shortDescription: Hand-burnished full-grain calfskin cap-toe Oxfords with cushioned leather insole.
products.description: Handcrafted by master shoemakers, our Premium Black Formal Shoes feature a sleek cap-toe silhouette, full leather lining, and a durable anti-slip gentleman’s heel built for formal excellence.

products.name: Classic Brown Leather Shoes
products.shortDescription: Rich hand-antiqued cognac leather derby brogues with artisanal wingtip detailing.
products.description: Each pair of Classic Brown Leather Shoes is hand-burnished with natural waxes to create a rich patina. Memory-foam arch support ensures effortless comfort from morning meetings to evening receptions.

products.name: White Casual Sneakers
products.shortDescription: Minimalist low-top smooth leather court sneakers with stitched cupsole construction.
products.description: Clean architectural lines meet everyday versatility. Our White Casual Sneakers pair supple matte leather uppers with a high-density rubber cupsole that looks sharp with chinos, denim, or tailored trousers.
products.fabricOrMaterial: Smooth Nappa Action Leather & Rubber Cupsole

products.name: Black Premium Sneakers
products.shortDescription: Monochrome black leather and suede-paneled luxury urban sneakers.
products.description: Designed for sleek nocturnal sophistication, the Black Premium Sneakers combine full-grain leather with tactile suede overlays and waxed cotton laces.

products.name: Brown Casual Loafers
products.shortDescription: Slip-on penny driving loafers in supple tumbled leather with flexible moccasin stitching.
products.description: Effortless slip-on luxury for weekend drives and smart-casual gatherings. Hand-stitched moccasin construction molds naturally to the foot.

products.name: Executive Black Steel Watch
products.shortDescription: 42mm brushed black stainless steel timepiece with sunray dial and luminous hands.
products.description: Commanding presence on the wrist. The Executive Black Steel Watch features a scratch-resistant mineral crystal, precision Japanese quartz movement, date window at 3 o’clock, and solid stainless steel link bracelet.

products.name: Classic Silver Chronograph
products.shortDescription: Multi-dial tachymeter chronograph in polished surgical steel with deployment clasp.
products.description: A tribute to precision horology. The Classic Silver Chronograph pairs a deep obsidian sub-dial layout with a polished silver bezel, stopwatch functionality, and 3ATM water resistance. Delivered in a signature Malik G presentation box.
products.fabricOrMaterial: Polished Stainless Steel & Hardened Mineral Glass

products.name: Premium Black Leather Watch
products.shortDescription: Ultra-thin dress watch with alligator-embossed genuine leather strap and gold indices.
products.description: Designed to slip effortlessly beneath a buttoned French cuff, the Premium Black Leather Watch balances classic dress proportions with warm gold baton hour markers.
products.fabricOrMaterial: Alloy Case & Genuine Embossed Leather Strap

products.name: Gold Accent Luxury Watch
products.shortDescription: Statement two-tone brushed gold and gunmetal timepiece with skeletal date calendar.
products.description: Our flagship timepiece at Malik G Collection. Featuring rich 18k gold-tone plating contrasted against charcoal steel links, luminous markers, and a precision sweep movement.

products.name: Minimalist Silver Watch
products.shortDescription: Clean Bauhaus-inspired 40mm dial paired with an adjustable stainless steel mesh strap.
products.description: Stripped of unnecessary ornament, the Minimalist Silver Watch celebrates pure proportion and legibility. Equipped with a breathable Milanese mesh band.

products.name: Royal Oud Perfume
products.shortDescription: Opulent woody-oriental Eau de Parfum with Cambodian Oud, saffron, and warm ambergris.
products.description: Our signature fragrance. Royal Oud opens with spicy Kashmiri saffron and bergamot before unfolding into a rich heart of aged agarwood (oud), Moroccan rose, and smoky sandalwood. Long-lasting 12+ hour projection crafted for unforgettable presence.

products.name: Black Musk Perfume
products.shortDescription: Seductive dark musk fragrance layered with black pepper, leather accord, and Madagascar vanilla.
products.description: Intense, smooth, and magnetic. Black Musk Perfume blends crisp spicy top notes with a velvety base of dark white musk, patchouli, and smoked cedarwood.

products.name: Premium Amber Fragrance
products.shortDescription: Warm resinous amber, cardamom, and roasted tonka bean for evening sophistication.
products.description: Golden warmth in a bottle. Premium Amber Fragrance wraps the wearer in an inviting aura of spiced cardamom, labdanum resin, and honeyed amber.

products.name: Classic Woody Perfume
products.shortDescription: Earthy vetiver, Atlas cedarwood, and crisp grapefruit for refined daily wear.
products.description: Inspired by timeless masculine colognes, Classic Woody Perfume balances zesty citrus top notes with dry, smoky Haitian vetiver and cedar.

products.name: Royal Night Eau de Parfum
products.shortDescription: Nocturnal blend of smoked incense, dark plum, leather, and golden patchouli.
products.description: Formulated specifically for festive occasions, weddings, and winter evenings. Royal Night commands attention with deep, velvety sillage that lingers on fabric for days.

products.name: Fresh Blue Eau de Parfum
products.shortDescription: Invigorating Mediterranean bergamot, marine accord, and ambroxan for warm Pakistani summers.
products.description: Crisp, clean, and energizing. Fresh Blue combines Calabrian bergamot and sea breeze notes with a masculine woody-ambroxan drydown.

products.name: Signature Reversible Leather Belt
products.shortDescription: Full-grain reversible black and brown leather belt with rotating brushed gold buckle.
products.description: Two essential belts in one refined design. Twist the brushed gold buckle to switch effortlessly between formal black and classic cognac brown leather.

products.name: Executive Bifold Leather Wallet
products.shortDescription: Slim handcrafted genuine leather bifold wallet with 8 card slots and gold-foil crest.
products.description: Slim profile engineered to fit front or back pockets without bulk. Hand-stitched from supple vegetable-tanned leather with RFID-shielded lining.
